name: Avocado Sourdough Toast
description: Artisanal toasted sourdough topped with creamy mashed Hass avocado, poached organic eggs, crumbled feta cheese, and cherry tomatoes, drizzled with premium olive oil and chili flakes.

name: The Royal English Breakfast
description: A hearty classic platter featuring two sunny-side-up eggs, grilled chicken sausages, hickory-smoked bacon, roasted mushrooms, grilled tomato, baked beans, and buttered toast.

name: Banarasi Kachori Sabzi
description: Crispy, deep-fried floured breads stuffed with a spiced lentil mixture, served with a hot, tangy, and flavorful potato curry (aloo sabzi) and sweet-sour pumpkin chutney.

name: Blueberry Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Three fluffy stack buttermilk pancakes folded with fresh blueberries, served warm with rich Vermont maple syrup, whipped butter, and a dusting of powdered sugar.

name: South Indian Idli-Vada Combo
description: Two soft, fluffy steamed rice-and-lentil cakes (Idli) paired with a crispy, savory fried lentil donut (Vada). Served with hot aromatic vegetable sambar and fresh coconut chutney.

name: Charcoal Smoked Butter Chicken Thali
description: Tender tandoori chicken cooked in a rich, velvety tomato-butter gravy finished with charcoal smoke. Accompanied by creamy dal makhani, garlic naan, basmati pulao, and fresh salad.

name: Truffle Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio rice slow-cooked with a rich wild mushroom broth, loaded with sautéed porcini and shiitake mushrooms, finished with Grana Padano parmesan and white truffle oil.

name: Healthy Quinoa Harvest Bowl
description: Organic red and white quinoa, roasted sweet potatoes, fresh sliced avocado, steamed baby kale, crispy spiced chickpeas, and organic microgreens, served with a creamy lemon-tahini dressing.

name: Slow-Cooked Awadhi Mutton Biryani
description: Premium long-grain Basmati rice layered with tender mutton marinated in yogurt and spices, slow-cooked in a sealed handi (dum method) with saffron, rose water, and kewra. Served with cucumber raita.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala Bowl
description: Tandoor-roasted paneer cubes, bell peppers, and onions simmered in a spiced onion-tomato masala gravy, served over a bed of fragrant jeera (cumin) rice and pickled laccha onions.

name: The Ultimate Truffle Burger
description: A juicy double-pattied gourmet beef tenderloin (or premium plant-based) burger on a toasted brioche bun, topped with melted Gruyère cheese, caramelized onions, and a rich black truffle aioli. Served with hand-cut sea salt fries.

name: Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon
description: A crisp-skinned fresh Atlantic salmon fillet pan-seared and served over sautéed green asparagus, roasted baby potatoes, and topped with a luxurious garlic-lemon herb butter sauce.

name: Neapolitan Margherita Pizza
description: Classic 12" sourdough pizza crust topped with authentic San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

name: Thai Green Curry with Jasmine Rice
description: Fragrant and spicy Thai green curry cooked with coconut milk, lemongrass, sweet basil, galangal, baby corn, bamboo shoots, and broccoli. Served with steamed aromatic Jasmine rice.

name: Signature Ghee Dal Khichdi
description: The ultimate Indian comfort food. A wholesome blend of fragrant rice and split yellow lentils (moong dal) cooked with mild spices, finished with a generous tempering of pure cow ghee, served with roasted papad and pickle.
